sections.name: Your efficiency philosophy in force now, rather than with Monday's order? This line would go first under how the work runs in your rulings: "Efficiency is a philosophy, not a wish (5 and 7 November): continuous and meticulous; every piece of work is also a chance to make the next cheaper. Look at everything: tokens, idle, handovers, rework and thrown tries, reviews, pictures, startup tools, build waits, and his time. Measured, not felt: the daily measures and the Monday audit; one change at a time, kept or dropped on its numbers; one waste noted at each item's end. The goal is falling cost per piece, each repeat of a kind clearly cheaper than the first. Never at quality's expense: waste goes, no bar is lowered. Its other half is full use of the week's allowance on useful work, no idle and no busywork, a tenth kept for Monday morning. Records and process stay under about 15% of spend, no bureaucracy; no extra money."
sections.recommendation: Yes. It costs nothing and replaces your 1 November efficiency line, folded into it. The advisor asked for this on your choice of 21:44. No web link: the answer is this page.
